expectations.text: Revokes ALL access including the OAuth grants/API tokens specifically (not just SSO/passwords) — and cites the integration-token risk pattern (e.g., the August 2025 Salesloft Drift breach where stolen OAuth tokens exposed Salesforce data at hundreds of organisations)
expectations.evidence: "Go into Salesforce's Connected Apps / OAuth grants and explicitly revoke... revoke any API keys"; cites "the Salesloft Drift breach (Aug 2025)... stolen OAuth tokens... exposed Salesforce data at 700+ downstream organizations"

expectations.text: Handles data: inventory, return in agreed format, certified deletion including backup-cycle expiry, and sub-processor deletion flow-down
expectations.evidence: "Inventory what customer contact data the vendor holds"; "return of the data in an agreed format"; "certified deletion... certificate of destruction... timeline for their backup-cycle expiry"; "deletion flows down to them [sub-processors] too"

expectations.text: Cleans technical debris: webhooks, connected-app registrations, service accounts, DNS/integrations
expectations.evidence: "DNS records (CNAMEs... SPF/DKIM)... any webhooks... integration user/service account... Connected Apps... scheduled sync jobs or middleware"

expectations.text: Covers contractual closure: termination assistance obligations, records retention, surviving clauses, final settlement
expectations.evidence: "any termination-assistance period, final invoice reconciliation, and records-retention requirements... Check survival clauses — confidentiality and audit rights typically survive"

expectations.text: Adds post-exit verification (e.g., ~30-day log review confirming no residual access) and feeds lessons back into the vendor register/tiering
expectations.evidence: "Thirty days after offboarding... confirm there is zero access... no API calls, no token refresh attempts"; "feed any lessons... back into your tiering and due-diligence criteria"
